title: Clarify thermite-design.md §4.2: flat closure bodies + named-only quantifier composition

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Added the 'Closure bodies are flat predicates' bullet to thermite-design.md §4.2: a combinator's closure body may not contain another combinator; nesting is via named spec fns (which may quantify boundedly, carry their own dec, and are audit-visible). Exact invariant stated. Matches REQ-6 + the validator (#40). Thesis now consistent with the enforced rule.
